vocabularyRows.body: taking the stage, creating something, and letting itself be seen
settling in, savoring what is good, and finishing what it starts
going first, taking the leap, and saying it to someone's face
hearing both sides, evening the scales, and making the room more beautiful
committing for years, doing the work, and keeping its word
